note: SOXL = 3x semiconductor bull ETF, SOXS = 3x bear. Times are US Eastern. change_pct = regular close vs prior close; afterhours_pct = last afterhours trade vs regular close.

news.headline: Alphabet Reportedly Bypassing Broadcom for HBM Procurement
news.summary: Alphabet is reportedly shifting its strategy to source High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) directly from memory suppliers, bypassing Broadcom to reduce costs.

news.headline: ASML Faces Potential Revenue Risk from U.S. Export Policy
news.summary: Analysts at Jefferies have identified that increasingly restrictive U.S. export policies, specifically under the MATCH Act, could put approximately 15% of ASML's revenue at risk.

news.headline: Compute Exchange Announces Live GPU Capacity Auction at NVIDIA GTC DC
news.summary: Compute Exchange will host a live auction for NVIDIA B200 and B300 GPU capacity on December 2, 2026, during the NVIDIA GTC DC event.

news.headline: NVIDIA Subject to Congressional Probe Regarding China Sales
news.summary: NVIDIA is facing a Congressional probe concerning its ties to the U.S. Commerce Department and potential sales of its technology to China.

news.headline: California Attorney General Launches Investigation into NVIDIA
news.summary: California has initiated an investigation into whether NVIDIA misled investors and the public regarding the presence of its chips in China despite federal export controls.

news.headline: Law Firms Announce Securities Investigations into Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.
news.summary: Multiple law firms have launched investigations into AMD following a short-seller report alleging the company continued to supply firmware to a blacklisted Chinese entity.

news.headline: 5C Group Joins NVIDIA Partner Network as Data Center Partner
news.summary: 5C Group has announced its designation as an NVIDIA Data Center Partner, focusing on the deployment of rack-scale AI infrastructure.

news.headline: TSMC Subsidiary Invests in Anthropic
news.summary: A TSMC subsidiary has subscribed to shares in AI company Anthropic, strengthening the foundry's ties with a major customer in the artificial intelligence sector.

news.headline: Purpose Investments Launches Purpose Micron (MU) Yield Shares ETF
news.summary: Purpose Investments has introduced a new single-stock ETF, the Purpose Micron (MU) Yield Shares ETF, designed to provide monthly income from Micron Technology stock.

news.headline: Democrats Open Probe Into Nvidia Influence on US Megaspeed Investigation
news.summary: Democratic lawmakers have initiated an investigation into NVIDIA's alleged influence regarding the US Megaspeed inquiry.

news.headline: Nvidia Eyes Inception Acquisition to Strengthen Nemotron AI Models
news.summary: NVIDIA is in advanced negotiations to acquire the AI startup Inception in a deal valued at over $500 million.
